properties.name: SLH-DSA-SHA2-128f (Stateless Hash-Based Digital Signature Algorithm)
properties.complexity_bounds: O(2^h * K) hash function calls, h=66, d=22, k=33, w=16
properties.algebraic_structure: Hypertree constructed from FORS (Forest-of-Random-Trees) and WOTS+ (Winternitz One-Time Signatures) using SHA-256

properties.name: Vectorized SHA-256 Compression Function
properties.complexity_bounds: Time: 64 rounds per 512-bit block; Space: O(1) 256-bit registers
properties.ring_modulus: Z_(2^32) modular addition and bitwise rotations
properties.algorithm_variant: Multi-buffer parallel SHA-256 processing over 4/8 SIMD lanes

properties.name: Intel SHA Extensions (SHA-NI)
properties.throughput_bounds: 4 rounds of SHA-256 state transformation per instruction execution

properties.microarchitectural_effect: Perform 2 rounds of SHA-256 compression function using state in xmm1 and xmm2 with message constants in xmm0
Perform intermediate message schedule calculation for 4 DWORDs of SHA-256 message array

properties.operation: Drives Merkle tree node hashing, WOTS+ leaf generation, and FORS tree evaluation

properties.vector_width: Hardware-accelerated 2-round pipeline for 256-bit hash state updates

properties.stage: Inner round compression loop executing 32 double-rounds for full 64-step SHA-256 block
Message schedule expansion stage for W[0..63] word derivation

properties.access_pattern: Read/Write 128-bit vector registers containing SHA-256 state variables (A, B, C, D) and (E, F, G, H)
Read/Write 128-bit vector registers containing packed message schedule words

evidence.reference: NIST FIPS 205: Stateless Hash-Based Digital Signature Standard
Intel 64 and IA-32 Architectures Software Developer's Manual, SHA New Instructions Reference
